definitions.explanation: The act of working; one's work performance or contributions.
How something operates or functions; its role or effect.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{働|はたら}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{感謝|かんしゃ}→感謝：00181_kansha⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{働|はたら}き⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|さ}がった→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧。
examples.english: The fever went down thanks to the medicine's effect.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{働|はたら}き{者|もの}→働き者：11528_hatarakimono⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.notes: {働|はたら}き{者|もの} = hard worker

examples.japanese: ⟦キャプテン→キャプテン：00258_kyaputen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{働|はたら}き⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{勝|か}った→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧。
examples.english: We won the game thanks to the captain's efforts.

notes:
USAGE: {働|はたら}き is the noun form of ⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧. It has two main uses: (1) work/labor/contribution, and (2) function/operation.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {働|はたら}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ (works well, functions well)
- {働|はたら}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ (functions poorly)
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{働|はたら}き (the function of ~)
- ⟦{働|はたら}き{者|もの}→働き者：11528_hatarakimono⟧ (hard worker)
- ⟦{働|はたら}き{盛|ざか}り→働き盛り：28201_hatarakizakari⟧ (prime working years)

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{働|はたら}き{方|かた}→働き方：25439_hatarakikata⟧ (way of working)
- ⟦{働|はたら}き{過|す}ぎ→働き過ぎ：28202_hatarakisugi⟧ (overwork)
- ⟦{共|とも}{働|ばたら}き→共働き：08564_tomobataraki⟧ (dual-income household)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧ - work, job (concrete)
- ⟦{労働|ろうどう}→労働：03785_roudou⟧ - labor (formal)
- ⟦{機能|きのう}→機能：13165_kinou⟧ - function (technical)
